name: @lekalo/adapter-sdk
description: Adapter SDK for the lekalo.target/v1 process protocol (issue #106): strict wire decoding, semantic validation, honest response builders with a validate-before-write boundary, deterministic ids and canonical bytes, path/scope helpers, bounded stderr logging, and the per-exchange serve loop. No telemetry, no network, no shell; adapters stay read-only by default and inside the host's confinement.
